name: GET /api/leadflow/records/:ref/save-gate - may this record be saved, and if not, which fields are missing?
description:
The NO BLANK NEXT gate from SOP §01, asked before the save rather than after (db775683-a5a1-4285-a6d9-f12467c1a2b2#AC1). The UI renders a NEXT composer that blocks submit until it is complete, and that is a CONVENIENCE; this is the control. A client bypassed with one curl meets exactly the same refusal, because the identical gate runs server-side on the write path.

THE REFUSAL IS STRUCTURED, NEVER A SENTENCE (db775683-a5a1-4285-a6d9-f12467c1a2b2#AC2). Each refusal names the field, why it is required and the remedy in the words the UI renders verbatim. "Please complete all fields" cannot be shown against a field, so the operator has to guess which one - and the gate fires on every save, so guessing is a tax on ordinary work. Every missing field is reported at once rather than one per round trip.

CLOSED WON IS NOT TERMINAL until onboarding is accepted and calendarized (db775683-a5a1-4285-a6d9-f12467c1a2b2#AC3). SOP §28 is explicit and the reason is that the handover is where deals are lost AFTER the signature - a record that goes quiet the moment payment clears is exactly the failure this rule prevents. So CLOSED_WON_ONBOARDING_PENDING still requires a NEXT while the other terminal stages do not.

THE OPEN-RECORD REQUIREMENT IS CHECKED TOO: owner, backup, stage, priority, permission state and last disposition. A record missing any of them is refused with the same per-field shape.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: An unknown record cannot be judged, so the gate says so
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
